title: Latent Space Jam: Layout Guided Video Synthesis
title_zh: 潜空间即兴：布局引导的视频合成

paragraphs.en: Adding control to video generation often requires training, which demands additional computational resources, data, or architectural changes. We propose a training-free approach that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion using coarse layouts. Our method operates in two passes: first, it steers spatiotemporal placement through prompt-guided cross-attention to produce a coarse visual guide; second, this guide conditions the same model to generate a high-quality, layout-consistent video. The approach enables coordinated motion with strong temporal consistency, supporting diverse trajectories and object interactions without additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, as well as visual quality across static, dynamic, and multi-object scene settings.
paragraphs.zh: 为视频生成添加控制通常需要训练，而训练需要额外的计算资源、数据或架构改动。 我们提出一种免训练的方法，利用预训练的视频扩散模型，通过粗略布局来控制物体的布局与运动。 我们的方法分两轮运行：第一轮通过提示引导的交叉注意力引导时空位置，生成粗略的视觉引导；第二轮用该引导对同一模型进行条件化，生成高质量、与布局一致的视频。 该方法能够实现具有强时间一致性的协调运动，支持多样的轨迹和物体交互，且无需额外训练。 大量实验表明，我们的方法在重叠度、轨迹精度以及静态、动态和多物体场景设置下的视觉质量方面，均持续优于先前工作。

paragraphs.en: Frame composition lies at the core of visual storytelling, defining the spatial structure through which meaning, motion, and narrative coherence emerge in video. Recent advances in text-based video generation ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) have demonstrated a remarkable ability to generate diverse and creative results from free-form text prompts. Yet the absence of explicit mechanisms for controlling spatial composition within and across frames continues to limit their applicability in structured visual storytelling.
paragraphs.zh: 画面构图位于视觉叙事的核心，定义了意义、运动和叙事连贯性在视频中涌现的空间结构。 基于文本的视频生成（HaCohen et al., 2026；Wan et al., 2025）的最新进展已展现出从自由格式文本提示生成多样且富有创意结果的卓越能力。 然而，缺乏在单帧内以及跨帧控制空间构图的显式机制，仍然限制了它们在结构化视觉叙事中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: We consider the problem of layout-guided text-to-video generation. Given a pre-trained off-the-shelf video generator, our goal is to steer its output to match a desired layout. Our method, Latent Space Justified Attention Mapping (JAM), allows the user to align the output video to a desired layout, guided by bounding boxes across frames, without additional training or fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究布局引导的文本到视频生成问题。 给定一个预训练的现成视频生成器，我们的目标是引导其输出以匹配期望的布局。 我们的方法——潜空间合理注意力映射（JAM），允许用户借助跨帧的边界框引导，将输出视频对齐到期望的布局，而无需额外的训练或微调。

paragraphs.en: Training-free layout-guided video generation has been explored in prior works ( Jain et al., 2024 ; Lian et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . However, existing methods fail in scenarios involving complex motion, exhibiting limited dynamics and poor temporal coherence. In contrast, our approach is able to synthesize complex and dynamic motion while preserving the high visual fidelity of the pre-trained video diffusion backbones, without introducing additional training or degrading their generative capacity. Furthermore, both subjective human evaluations and objective quantitative metrics demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms these prior approaches (see 5. Results ).
paragraphs.zh: 免训练的布局引导视频生成已在先前工作中被探索过（Jain et al., 2024；Lian et al., 2023；Ma et al., 2024；Qiu et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2025）。 然而，现有方法在涉及复杂运动的场景中会失败，表现出动态性有限和时间一致性差的问题。 相比之下，我们的方法能够在不引入额外训练或降低其生成能力的前提下，合成复杂且富有动态性的运动，同时保持预训练视频扩散主干模型的高视觉保真度。 此外，主观的人类评估和客观的量化指标都表明，我们的方法始终优于这些先前的方法（见 5. 结果）。

paragraphs.en: There is an inherent trade-off between layout adherence and visual quality: stronger layout regularization results in poorer visual quality. Instead of trying to achieve both goals simultaneously, and thus compromising on both, we take a different route. We split the pipeline into a guide generation stage followed by a refinement stage. Our key insight is that this allows us to push layout adherence to the maximum in the first stage, and rely on the robustness of modern video diffusion models in the refinement stage to fix the coarse intermediate results, thus circumventing the tradeoff between layout adherence and visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 布局一致性与视觉质量之间存在固有的权衡：更强的布局约束会导致更差的视觉质量。 我们没有试图同时实现这两个目标从而在两者之间做出妥协，而是采取了另一条路线。 我们将流程拆分为引导生成阶段和随后的精修阶段。 我们的核心见解是：这使我们能够在第一阶段将布局一致性推到最大，并依靠现代视频扩散模型的鲁棒性在精修阶段修复粗糙的中间结果，从而规避布局一致性与视觉质量之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by attention-based control methods in text-to-image generation ( Chefer et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2023 ) , we manipulate the cross-attention maps of pre-trained video diffusion models to generate coarse guidance. However, extending these approaches to video is not straightforward: the added temporal dimension makes it more difficult to control object placement consistently across frames, and the scale of video DiT models makes optimization across all layers impractical. In contrast, we show that effective control can be achieved through selective intervention, modifying only a small subset of cross-attention layers and a limited number of diffusion steps. As a result, our method can be executed on a single GPU, with minimal time overhead relative to the inference time of the underlying backbone models.
paragraphs.zh: 受文本到图像生成中基于注意力的控制方法（Chefer et al., 2023；Xie et al., 2023）的启发，我们通过操纵预训练视频扩散模型的交叉注意力图来生成粗略引导。 然而，将这些方法扩展到视频并非易事：新增的时间维度使得跨帧一致地控制物体位置变得更加困难，且视频 DiT 模型的规模使得在所有层上进行优化并不现实。 相比之下，我们表明可以通过选择性干预实现有效控制，即仅修改一小部分交叉注意力层和有限数量的扩散步骤。 因此，我们的方法可以在单个 GPU 上运行，且相对于底层骨干模型的推理时间，时间开销极小。

paragraphs.en: In practice, we treat a pre-trained diffusion transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) video generator as a fixed computational graph and optimize its latent input rather than its weights. Given a textual prompt and a spatiotemporal layout, we first steer an intermediate video toward the desired structure by optimizing this latent variable, using a loss applied to selected cross-attention layers of the DiT to align them with the provided bounding boxes. Then, we rerun the generator and inject the resulting video at an early diffusion timestep, using it as a coarse prior that the model refines into the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，我们将预训练的扩散 Transformer（DiT）（Peebles and Xie, 2023）视频生成器视为一个固定的计算图，并优化其潜在输入而非其权重。 给定一个文本提示和一个时空布局，我们首先通过优化该潜在变量，利用作用于 DiT 中选定交叉注意力层的损失，将中间视频引导至目标结构，使其与所提供的边界框对齐。 然后，我们重新运行生成器，并在较早的扩散时间步注入所得视频，将其作为粗略先验，由模型进一步精炼为最终结果。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce a training-free framework for layout-guided text-to-video generation that enables explicit control over spatial composition and motion using simple bounding-box supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无需训练的布局引导文本到视频生成框架，通过简单的边界框监督实现对空间构图和运动的显式控制。

paragraphs.en: We present the importance of using a two-stage pipeline: utilizing layout guidance videos as priors to the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了使用两阶段流程的重要性：利用布局引导视频作为先验来生成最终结果。

paragraphs.en: We show that minimal intervention in a pre-trained video diffusion model via a subset of its cross-attention layers is sufficient to steer generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，通过预训练视频扩散模型的少量交叉注意力层进行最小干预，即可引导生成过程。

paragraphs.en: We validate our approach through extensive experiments, demonstrating superior performance over prior methods across complex, dynamic, and multi-object scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过大量实验验证了我们的方法，证明了其在复杂、动态和多目标场景中相较于以往方法的卓越性能。

paragraphs.en: Our work falls within the line of research on training-free controllability for diffusion models, which exploits internal attention representations as test-time control signals. We address the problem of spatiotemporal layout and motion control in video generation, achieving structured control without training, fine-tuning, or architectural modification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作属于免训练扩散模型可控性研究方向，该方向利用内部注意力表示作为测试时的控制信号。 我们解决视频生成中的时空布局与运动控制问题，在不进行训练、微调或架构修改的情况下实现结构化控制。

sents.en: We address the problem of spatiotemporal layout and motion control in video generation, achieving structured control without training, fine-tuning, or architectural modification.
sents.zh: 我们解决视频生成中的时空布局与运动控制问题，在不进行训练、微调或架构修改的情况下实现结构化控制。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work in text-to-image synthesis demonstrates that cross-attention can be used as an interface for test-time control. Several methods ( Chefer et al., 2023 ; Epstein et al., 2023 ) interpret attention as a form of semantic grounding and introduce latent optimization or self-guidance strategies to enforce token presence and object saliency during sampling. Others ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2023 ; Phung et al., 2024 ) reshape attention maps to align text tokens with user specified spatial layouts or regions, enabling box and region constrained generation. Additional approaches ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) focus on attention segregation, refocusing, and mutual self-attention control to improve compositionality and consistency. Collectively, these works establish that attention is not merely an internal mechanism, but a controllable structure that can be manipulated at inference time to impose semantic and spatial constraints without retraining the model.
paragraphs.zh: 文生图合成领域越来越多的研究表明，交叉注意力可以作为一种测试时控制的接口。 若干方法（Chefer et al., 2023；Epstein et al., 2023）将注意力解释为一种语义基础形式，并引入潜空间优化或自引导策略，以在采样过程中强制保证词元的存在性和对象的显著性。 另一些方法（Chen et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2023；Phung et al., 2024）对注意力图进行重塑，使文本词元与用户指定的空间布局或区域对齐，从而实现基于框和区域的受限生成。 还有一些方法（Agarwal et al., 2023；Cao et al., 2023）专注于注意力分离、重聚焦和相互自注意力控制，以提升组合性和一致性。 总而言之，这些工作确立了注意力不仅仅是一种内部机制，而是一种可控结构，可以在推理时对其进行操纵，从而在不重新训练模型的情况下施加语义和空间约束。

paragraphs.en: In video generation, most controllable methods rely on additional training or fine-tuning. A common strategy is to augment pre-trained video diffusion models with external adapters or control branches conditioned on structural signals such as edges or depth ( Hu and Xu, 2023 ) , pose or trajectories ( Hu, 2024 ; Karras et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , a combination of these signals ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , or camera parameters ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . These approaches enable explicit control over motion, layout, and viewpoint. However, they require paired supervision, dedicated retraining, and model modification, which restricts their applicability and adds significant computational cost.

paragraphs.en: Recently, several works have explored training-free control for text-to-video diffusion models. Peekaboo ( Jain et al., 2024 ) and TrailBlazer ( Ma et al., 2024 ) intervene in the cross-attention layers of a pretrained model to align foreground motion with user-specified guidance. FreeTraj ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) adopts a similar strategy but further improves controllability by imposing guidance on both attention maps and the latent noise. LVD ( Lian et al., 2023 ) focuses on generating a layout guide with an LLM, producing bounding box trajectories across scenes to steer object placement. SwitchCraft ( Xu et al., 2026 ) and TempoControl ( Schiber et al., 2026 ) apply a training-free approach to modify contemporary DiT video models, but focus only on temporal control.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，已有若干工作探索了面向文本到视频扩散模型的无训练控制方法。 Peekaboo（Jain et al., 2024）和 TrailBlazer（Ma et al., 2024）通过干预预训练模型的交叉注意力层，使前景运动与用户指定的引导保持一致。 FreeTraj（Qiu et al., 2024）采用类似策略，但通过对注意力图和潜在噪声同时施加引导，进一步提升了可控性。 LVD（Lian et al., 2023）专注于利用大语言模型生成布局引导，跨场景生成边界框轨迹来引导物体的放置。 SwitchCraft（Xu et al., 2026）和 TempoControl（Schiber et al., 2026）将无训练方法应用于当代 DiT 视频模型，但仅关注时间维度上的控制。

paragraphs.en: In contrast to prior training-free video control methods that rely on direct attention and latent noise manipulation ( Jain et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2024 ) , our approach adopts an optimization-based attention alignment strategy that scales effectively to complex spatiotemporal layouts. paragraphs.en: Enforcing layout adherence conflicts with the visual quality of a generated video. In the early stage of generating the layout-guided video, more complex motion requires stronger layout regularization, thereby reducing visual fidelity. Our main insight is that we can circumvent this tradeoff via a two-stage process. We first allow better layout adherence at the cost of visual quality, and then enhance this low-quality (but layout-accurate) guiding video.
paragraphs.zh: 强制遵循布局与生成视频的视觉质量存在冲突。 在生成布局引导视频的早期阶段，更复杂的运动需要更强的布局正则化，从而降低视觉保真度。 我们的主要见解是，可以通过两阶段过程来规避这种权衡。 我们首先以牺牲视觉质量为代价获得更好的布局遵循，然后增强这个低质量（但布局准确）的引导视频。

paragraphs.en: The enhancement is achieved using existing state-of-the-art video diffusion models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ) , which can be adapted to accept a video input, turning them into robust quality amplifiers that can correct visually poor videos while maintaining object locations and motion.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 provides an overview of our pipeline. We present a two-stage training-free layout-guided video synthesis framework that enables explicit control in both time and space over videos generated by a pre-trained video diffusion model, without any finetuning of model parameters. Given a text prompt and user-specified layout constraints in the form of bounding boxes across frames, we enforce the model to generate a guiding video that adheres to these layout constraints. Then, we use this guiding video as input to a video-to-video pipeline to generate the final video.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 概述了我们的流程。 我们提出了一个两阶段的免训练布局引导视频合成框架，它能够对预训练视频扩散模型生成的视频在时间和空间上进行显式控制，且无需对模型参数进行任何微调。 给定一个文本提示词和用户以跨帧边界框形式指定的布局约束，我们强制模型生成符合这些布局约束的引导视频。 然后，我们将该引导视频作为视频到视频流程的输入，生成最终的视频。

paragraphs.en: Following the first stage, we adapt the second stage into a video-to-video pipeline by injecting the prior at an early diffusion time-step. At early time-steps, the diffusion process primarily governs the global layout, while later steps refine visual details ( Wang and Vastola, 2023 ) . Specifically, similar to ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , we inject a noisy version of the video prior at a selected time-step, matching its noise level to the step, and continue denoising to generate the final video with restored visual fidelity. Technical details are provided in the supplemental.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一阶段之后，我们将第二阶段改造为视频到视频的流程，方法是在较早的扩散时间步注入先验。 在较早的时间步，扩散过程主要控制全局布局，而较晚的时间步则细化视觉细节（Wang and Vastola, 2023）。 具体而言，类似于（Meng et al., 2022），我们在选定的时间步注入视频先验的加噪版本，使其噪声水平与该时间步相匹配，然后继续去噪以生成恢复视觉保真度的最终视频。 技术细节见补充材料。

sents.en: Following the first stage, we adapt the second stage into a video-to-video pipeline by injecting the prior at an early diffusion time-step.
sents.zh: 在第一阶段之后，我们将第二阶段改造为视频到视频的流程，方法是在较早的扩散时间步注入先验。

sents.en: At early time-steps, the diffusion process primarily governs the global layout, while later steps refine visual details ( Wang and Vastola, 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 在较早的时间步，扩散过程主要控制全局布局，而较晚的时间步则细化视觉细节（Wang and Vastola, 2023）。

sents.en: Specifically, similar to ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , we inject a noisy version of the video prior at a selected time-step, matching its noise level to the step, and continue denoising to generate the final video with restored visual fidelity.
sents.zh: 具体而言，类似于（Meng et al., 2022），我们在选定的时间步注入视频先验的加噪版本，使其噪声水平与该时间步相匹配，然后继续去噪以生成恢复视觉保真度的最终视频。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward strategy to generate the low-fidelity layout prior is to leverage the strong semantic and compositional capabilities of recent text-to-image (T2I) models. Since the guide is only required to encode coarse spatial layout and approximate object motion, rather than high visual quality, it is natural to generate a sequence of images that satisfy the bounding-box constraints on a frame-by-frame basis and treat this sequence as a guiding video. This can be implemented by applying layout-guided and inpainting techniques ( Li et al., 2023 ; Labs, 2024 ) to independently generate a static background image and the objects specified in the text prompt, and then placing and propagating these objects across frames according to the provided layout constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 生成低保真度布局先验的一个直接策略是利用近期文本到图像（T2I）模型强大的语义和组合能力。 由于该引导只需要编码粗略的空间布局和近似的物体运动，而无需具备较高的视觉质量，因此很自然的做法是逐帧生成一系列满足边界框约束的图像，并将该序列视为引导视频。 这可以通过应用布局引导和修复技术（Li et al., 2023; Labs, 2024）来独立生成静态背景图像以及文本提示中指定的物体，然后根据给定的布局约束将这些物体放置并传播到各帧中来加以实现。

paragraphs.en: As explained in section 5.1 and table 1 , this simple baseline (T2I) surprisingly matches or outperforms previous layout-guided video generation methods ( Jain et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) on refined videos, achieving comparable or better performance across all datasets in overlap accuracy (IoU, AP50) and trajectory accuracy (CD, I., I-AP50).

paragraphs.en: Instead of relying on external text-to-image models to generate a prior, we leverage the video diffusion model itself to produce a layout-aware guidance signal. Specifically, we exploit the powerful generative capacity of video diffusion models to synthesize a guiding video that exhibits coherent motion while respecting specified layout constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不再依赖外部文本到图像模型来生成先验，而是利用视频扩散模型本身来产生布局感知的引导信号。 具体而言，我们利用视频扩散模型强大的生成能力来合成一段引导视频，该视频既呈现出连贯的运动，又遵循指定的布局约束。

paragraphs.en: To enforce spatial correspondence between the generated video and the target layout, we take inspiration from attention-based image editing methods ( Xie et al., 2023 ; Chefer et al., 2023 ) . At a high level, we control the output of a video diffusion model by steering its cross-attention maps towards the provided layout.
paragraphs.zh: 为了强化生成视频与目标布局之间的空间对应关系，我们借鉴了基于注意力的图像编辑方法（Xie et al., 2023；Chefer et al., 2023）。 从较高层面来看，我们通过将视频扩散模型的交叉注意力图引导至所提供的布局，来控制其输出。

paragraphs.en: This optimization prioritizes structural alignment over visual quality. Stronger attention constraints enforce the target layout more accurately, but degrade appearance. As stated earlier, a coarse video is sufficient to guide generation when injected at early diffusion steps. This allows us to optimize aggressively for layout in this stage and rely on a second diffusion pass to restore visual fidelity. We therefore obtain a controllable tradeoff between structure and appearance, which we demonstrate in Figure 5 and discuss further in the 5. Results section.

paragraphs.en: To ensure a comprehensive evaluation across varying levels of difficulty, we consider three data categories: Static, Dynamic, and Multi. These contain approximately 40, 40, and 20 layouts, respectively, for a total of about 100 layouts. The Static set contains single-object layouts with limited motion, initially based on videos from the Davis dataset ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) . The Dynamic set follows the same single-object structure with similar textual prompts as the Static set, but introduces strong dynamic motion. The Multi set represents the most challenging scenario, featuring multiple objects with strong dynamic motion in a single video and custom textual prompts. For all datasets, layout guidance is provided in the form of binary video masks, which are created by the authors and to be publicly released alongside the textual prompts.

paragraphs.en: We present results in Table 1 , additional results are in the supplemental. To evaluate the control of the layout on the generated output, we use a set of complementary metrics that measure both semantic and spatial accuracy between the ground truth layout and bounding boxes predicted by an open-vocabulary segmentation model ( Minderer et al., 2022 ) . Intersection over Union (IoU) measures the average overlap between predicted and ground-truth object masks across all objects and frames, providing an overall layout accuracy score. Average precision@50% (AP50) evaluates frame-level correctness by considering a prediction correct when it overlaps the ground truth by at least 50%, indicating whether objects appear in the intended regions per frame. To evaluate motion fidelity with respect to the target trajectory beyond standard overlap accuracy, we also report Centroid Distance (CD), Intersection, and Intersection-AP50 (I-AP50). CD measures how far the predicted object centers are from the ground-truth centers across all objects and frames. Intersection measures the raw overlapping area between predicted and ground-truth masks, and I-AP50 applies the detection-style metric based on the raw intersection area rather than IoU. Together, these metrics quantify how faithfully the generated videos follow the provided layouts. We employ Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) to assess video quality against a set of 150 videos from Davis ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) , and CLIP Similarity (ClipSim) ( Radford et al., 2021 ) to measure alignment with the textual prompts.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we conduct a user study comparing our method with previous approaches on a subset of fifteen videos (five from each dataset). The study involves approximately sixty reviewers, including individuals with visual arts backgrounds as well as participants from non-visual backgrounds. In total, we collected 250 responses. Participants evaluated the generated videos along three dimensions: fidelity to the prompt, fidelity to the layout, and aesthetic quality. The aggregated results are shown in Table 2 . We observe that the straightforward Text-to-Video (T2V) method achieves strong visual quality (VQ) and prompt adherence, but performs poorly in adhering to layout guidance. Our approach significantly outperforms all baselines in layout adherence. In terms of VQ and prompt adherence, it performs competitively, surpassing all other methods except T2V. Notably, on certain datasets, our method also exceeds T2V in visual quality or prompt alignment.

paragraphs.en: In Table 3 we study which layers to select and how many are needed. Instead of fixing a single subset, we randomly sample a subset from the chosen layer range at each diffusion timestep. This strategy benefits from representations across the full layer set while reducing computational cost for high-resolution inputs. Our results indicate that early layers are especially beneficial. Specifically, during the guide generation stage (left columns block), we observe higher IoU and AP50 and lower CD for early layer ranges (0–10, 10–20, 0–20) compared to later ranges (20–30, 30–40, 20–40). This advantage consistently propagates to the refinement stage (right columns block).
paragraphs.zh: 在表3中，我们研究了应选择哪些层以及需要多少层。 我们没有固定单一子集，而是在每个扩散时间步从所选层范围中随机采样一个子集。 这一策略在利用完整层集合表征的同时，降低了高分辨率输入的计算成本。 我们的结果表明，早期层尤其有益。 具体而言，在引导生成阶段（左侧列块）中，我们观察到早期层范围（0–10、10–20、0–20）相比后期范围（20–30、30–40、20–40）具有更高的IoU和AP50，以及更低的CD。 这一优势持续传递到细化阶段（右侧列块）。

paragraphs.en: Despite its strong performance, the approach has several limitations. It does not explicitly separate camera motion from object motion: bounding boxes define where content should appear over time, but they do not specify whether changes should arise from object movement or from camera transformations, which can lead to ambiguous or unintended behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管该方法性能强劲，但仍存在若干局限性。 它没有显式地将相机运动与物体运动分离开来：边界框定义了内容应随时间出现的位置，但并未指明变化应源于物体移动还是相机变换，这可能导致模糊或非预期的行为。

paragraphs.en: Performance may decrease in complex situations, such as scenes with detailed motion, multiple interacting objects, or crowded scene layouts. Although we demonstrate results in such settings, they remain challenging and leave room for further improvement. An important direction for future work will be to address these challenges, which may lead to more robust layout-guided video generation.

paragraphs.en: We present a training-free approach for layout-guided text-to-video generation that enables explicit control over spatial composition and object motion while preserving the generative strength of modern video diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无需训练的布局引导文生视频方法，该方法能够在保留现代视频扩散模型生成能力的同时，实现对空间构图和物体运动的显式控制。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that minimal intervention at inference time is sufficient to steer pre-trained models toward user-specified spatiotemporal layouts without compromising visual fidelity or requiring additional training. Through extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluation, we demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods across static, dynamic, and multi-object scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，在推理阶段进行最小程度的干预，就足以引导预训练模型生成用户指定的时空布局，而无需额外的训练，也不会损害视觉保真度。 通过大量的定量与定性评估，我们证明了该方法在静态、动态和多物体场景中均比先前方法取得了一致的改进。
